Package hadur2.core.move

Class AesRecord

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.move.AesRecord
public final class AesRecord extends Object
AES-1: the decision record, one line per wave at the three-option surf's first rating of it, with every term of each option's danger before they are blended, so the blend can be refitted offline against the bullet the engine says was fired (docs/plan-aes.md, data/tools/aes_rank.py). Measurement only: a bench build turns it on, the competition jar never does, and nothing here changes what the surf does.

The line, after the AES,round,tick, the duel puts in front: fireTime,power,firing,sourceX,sourceY,chosen,views, (firing 1 for a wave a real bullet rides, 0 for a virtual one such as MOVE-11's gun-heat wave), then for each option in ordinal order (counter-clockwise, stop, clockwise) present,total, and the FIXED terms below followed by the 2 * views + 1 view parts of MoveController.getDangerScore. An option with no plan on the wave writes 0 and no more fields for it.
